name: Spring Solar
old_description: Spring Solar has been serving homeowners since 2016, operating as an efficient, low-overhead company that keeps pricing competitive and transparent. We skip the big corporate price tags and pass those savings directly to you.
about:
Spring Solar was founded in 2016 in Bluffdale, Utah, as a family-owned business focused on residential and commercial solar installation. The company began with a mission to make solar power accessible and affordable for homeowners and businesses across the Intermountain West.

The company designs, permits, and installs custom solar photovoltaic systems, including rooftop panels, inverters, and battery storage. Its team manages the entire process from initial energy assessment through final inspection and system activation, and provides real-time production monitoring for every installation. Spring Solar serves customers throughout Utah, Wyoming, and Colorado, with a service area that includes Salt Lake City, Park City, and surrounding communities.

Spring Solar works primarily with homeowners whose monthly electricity bills exceed $100 and with businesses seeking a return on investment within five years. The company has installed systems for residents in Bluffdale, West Jordan, and Draper, as well as for commercial clients looking to reduce operating costs and capture tax incentives.

Spring Solar differentiates itself with a low-price guarantee that matches or beats any competitor’s quote, 25-year product and manufacturer warranties, and a family-owned structure that emphasizes personalized service. The firm is also a Triple‑E Installer Partner with APsystems, offering microinverter technology backed by a 2026 Best of SLC Award.
